name: Potter Webster Company
old_description: Locally owned and nationally known, Potter Webster is proud to be your parts supplier and we strive every day to be the best at what we do. As a family owned business since 1940, we have worked hard to bring quality parts and service to our industry. With the support of our loyal customers, we now house over 120 product lines in our 51,000 square ft Portland warehouse; this means we’ll have the parts you need when you need them. Our mission is to keep your vehicles safely on the road and making you money. Value is what Potter Webster Company is all about. A tried and true approach to understanding the needs of our customers and fulfilling those needs has built our reputation of being an icon in the market. We constantly examine our offerings to make sure that we are providing the best choice for our customers.
about:
Potter Webster Company has operated from Portland, Oregon since 1940 as a family-owned business. The company began as a local parts supplier and has grown into a nationally recognized distributor while remaining under family ownership.

The company stocks more than 120 product lines across a 51,000-square-foot warehouse, supplying components for commercial trucks and trailers. In addition to distribution, Potter Webster runs a service shop that performs light trailer repairs, machine-shop work, U-bolt bending, custom cable fabrication, fan-clutch rebuilding, and brake-shoe relining. The facility also supports hydraulic and PTO services, driveline work, and axle-system assembly.

Customers include fleet operators, repair shops, and dealers serving the heavy-duty transportation sector. The inventory features brands such as Hendrickson trailer-axle parts, Dana/Spicer drivetrain components, and Denso starters and alternators under the Power Edge label. Past acquisitions — including the assets of R.W. Conroy Company and Customer Parts & Trailer Supply — expanded the product range and led to the Custom Trailer Parts line.

The company states its mission is to keep vehicles safely on the road and profitable for their owners. A focus on value and on understanding customer needs has guided its evolution from a single location to a multi-line supplier with in-house service capabilities.
